description: This dataset records electrical consumption at DAEWOO Steel in Gwangyang, South Korea. UCI documents 35,040 observations with energy in kWh, reactive energy in kVarh, power factors, weekday information, seconds from midnight and load categories. The CSV is free under CC BY 4.0. Coverage is one steel facility; the original landing page does not establish the calendar interval, while a later Zenodo copy describes 2018 and fifteen-minute observations. A limitation is conflicting carbon-dioxide units: the field name suggests tonnes but UCI labels it ppm, so it must not be converted without clarification. The Kaggle mirror incorrectly expands NSM as normalised solar energy; the original defines seconds from midnight. Simulation uses include industrial electricity-demand models and load-class prediction. It complements data-open-power-system-data with plant-level demand. The earlier rejection as outside built-environment scope overlooks industrial infrastructure reuse. No consumption values, emissions or temporal continuity were checked.
